body: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
modernText: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
message: The day you're actually in gets to be the one you celebrate. Not someday, not after the next thing, this one.

body: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
modernText: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
message: A good mood is a doorway, and this says walk through it grateful. No need to brace for it to end, just enjoy being here.

body: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
modernText: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
message: The good you're feeling isn't a fluke, it's in character. There's more where this came from, and it doesn't run out.

body: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
modernText: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
message: Permission, twice over, to actually be glad. The verse repeats itself because joy is worth saying again.

body: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
modernText: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
message: On a good day, gratitude isn't a stretch, it's the easiest it'll ever be. Lean all the way in.

body: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
modernText: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
message: That thing that made today good counts as a gift, worth naming and tracing back to its source.

body: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
modernText: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
message: The heart that was helped now gets to be glad, out loud. Relief turning into something that sings.

body: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
modernText: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
message: Not a little joy, a fulness of it. This says the good you're feeling has an endless supply behind it.

body: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our LORD: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
modernText: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
message: On a good day, this reminds you the joy isn't just a nice feeling, it's fuel. Let it build you up.

body: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
modernText: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
message: Even the hard parts of the story were quietly working toward moments like this one. Today is some of the good showing up.

body: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
modernText: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
message: Good cheer with a backbone behind it. The gladness you feel is standing on something that already won.

body: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
modernText: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
message: Taste it, this says, like joy is something to savor, not just acknowledge. You're allowed to enjoy the flavor of a good day.

body: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
modernText: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
message: A good day is worth talking about. Go ahead and be the person who can't stop mentioning the thing that went right.

body: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: Short and sure: he is good. On a day you feel it, this just agrees with you and says it back.

body: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
modernText: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
message: A spontaneous 'how good is this' moment, captured in a verse. Joy that just wants to point and marvel.

body: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
modernText: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
message: Here's the wild part: the joy goes both ways. On a good day, picture being delighted in, not just delighting.

body: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
modernText: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
message: More than you asked for, more than you thought to ask for. A good day as a small taste of that overflow.

body: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
modernText: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
message: Grace that abounds, not just squeaks by. The good you're in is the abounding kind, with extra.

body: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
modernText: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
message: When things are good, there's a song in it. Strength and gladness in the same breath, nothing to balance out.

body: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
modernText: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!
message: Good news wants to be shared. This gives you permission to tell someone about the thing that lit you up.

body: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
modernText: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
message: A new song for a new, good day. Not the tired old tune, something fresh for how you actually feel right now.

body: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
modernText: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
message: Day to day, the good keeps showing up. Today's just the latest installment, and it counts.

body: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
modernText: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
message: Joy as a decision and a delight at once. On a good day, the choosing is easy, so enjoy it fully.

body: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
modernText: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
message: If you've got breath, you qualify. The simplest invitation to join in on a good day: just be glad you're here.

body: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
modernText: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
message: Joy too big for words, the verse says. If today's gladness is hard to explain, that might be exactly the kind it means.

body: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
modernText: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
message: On a good day, even the sky seems to be in on it. Look up, the whole thing is quietly celebrating too.

body: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
modernText: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
message: Some good lands straight in the heart and just makes it glad. No reason to question it, let it rejoice.

body: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
modernText: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
message: Gladness that comes from being looked at kindly. A good day as the warmth of a face turned toward you.

body: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
modernText: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
message: Not just relief, joy. On a good day, the gladness gets to be the whole point, not a side effect.

body: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
modernText: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, think about these things.
message: A good day is the perfect time to dwell on the good. Let your mind rest on the lovely thing instead of scanning for the next problem.

body: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
modernText: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
message: Even the ordinary good of a nice day gets to mean something. Joy woven right into whatever you're up to.

body: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
modernText: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
message: Whole-hearted, not half. On a good day, you don't have to hold any of the gladness back.

body: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
modernText: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
message: The stated goal is your joy, full, not partial. Today, let it be as full as it wants to be.

body: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: The good mood and the good God, matched. A day that just confirms what the verse already says.

body: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
modernText: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
message: Goodness crowning the year, dripping off the edges. A good day as one of those drops landing right on you.

body: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
modernText: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
message: Loaded up with good things, daily. On a day you can feel it, this says it's always been happening, you just noticed today.

body: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
modernText: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
message: No good thing held back from you. The good you're in isn't the exception, it's the pattern.

body: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
modernText: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.
message: Good things prepared ahead of time, waiting for you. Today might be one that was set aside with your name on it.

body: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
modernText: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
message: The good isn't random, it's faithful. A day like this is that faithfulness showing its face.

body: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
modernText: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
message: Good to those who waited, and maybe you did, for this. Today's gladness as the arrival of something you hoped for.

body: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
modernText: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
message: Full of joy, from simply being in good company. A good day as the feeling of being gladly near someone.

body: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
modernText: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
message: The original review of creation: very good. On a day that feels good, you're echoing the first thing ever said about the world.

body: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
modernText: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
message: A stockpile of goodness, laid up and waiting. Today's a withdrawal from a store that's always been there.

body: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
modernText: For of him, and through him, and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
message: Everything running back to one good source. On a good day, it's easy to feel how it all connects.

body: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
modernText: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
message: Goodness literally chasing you down. On a good day, it caught up, and you got to notice.

body: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
modernText: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
message: Good to all, which includes you, today, specifically. Not earned, just extended.

body: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
modernText: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
message: Talking to your own soul on a good day: don't miss this, bless it, let yourself fully register the good.

body: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
modernText: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
message: The one day it's easy to remember the benefits, remember them hard. Bank this feeling for later.

body: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
modernText: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
message: Forgiven and healed, the ground under a good mood. Today's lightness has roots deeper than today.

body: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
modernText: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
message: Crowned, not just patted on the head. A good day as a reminder of how you're actually regarded, with tenderness.

body: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
modernText: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
message: Permission to just be glad, because something good actually happened. No need to downplay it, name the great thing and enjoy it.

body: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
modernText: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
message: If today feels like dancing after a hard stretch, that's worth noticing. The turn from heavy to light is real, and you get to feel it.

body: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
modernText: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
message: Good days are made for saying something, not swallowing it. Let the gladness have a voice instead of keeping it polite and quiet.

body: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
modernText: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
message: Three verbs for being happy, stacked up like the verse can't contain it. Match that energy, nothing to hold back today.

body: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
modernText: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
message: Rejoicing called comely, like gladness suits you, looks good on you. A good mood as the thing that fits you best.

body: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
modernText: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
message: The heart getting to rejoice, not just cope. On a good day, let the gladness go all the way down.

body: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
modernText: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
message: A new song for a new feeling. When things are good, you don't have to keep humming the old worried tune.

body: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
modernText: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
message: Big, physical, unembarrassed joy. The verse basically says make some noise about it, so go ahead and be glad out loud.

body: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
modernText: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
message: Some good is better than the best thing you can name. This says the kindness you're feeling tops even life itself.

body: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
modernText: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
message: Satisfied, actually full, not still reaching. A rare, good feeling, and the verse says let your lips be joyful about it.

body: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
modernText: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
message: Everybody's invited to be glad, the whole earth. On a good day, you're just joining a chorus that's already going.

body: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
modernText: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth.
message: Gladness on a scale bigger than you, nations-wide. Your good mood is part of something much larger than today.

body: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
modernText: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
message: Greatly rejoice, not mildly. When it's good, the verse gives you room to be all the way glad about it.

body: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
modernText: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
message: Blessed is the person who can recognize the good when it comes. Today you heard it, and that's its own gift.

body: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
modernText: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
message: Satisfied early, so the whole day can be glad. When good lands in the morning, it colors everything after it.

body: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
modernText: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
message: Made glad by the work of someone's hands, including the ordinary good of a day well-made. Gladness with a source behind it.

body: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
modernText: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
message: An invitation, warm and casual, come sing. On a good day, this just wants you to join in the gladness.

body: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
modernText: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
message: Showing up grateful rather than grasping. A good day is the easiest day to walk in thankful.

body: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
modernText: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
message: Marvellous things, worth a brand-new song. When good happens, it deserves more than the usual quiet nod.

body: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
modernText: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
message: The whole earth making a joyful noise, and you're allowed to be loud in it. Good moods don't have to be kept to yourself.

body: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
modernText: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
message: A lifelong commitment to gladness, renewed on good days like this one. Let today add to the song.

body: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
modernText: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
message: Sweet is the word, not heavy. On a good day, even your thinking gets to be pleasant, a nice place to rest your mind.

body: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
modernText: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
message: A good day makes you want to give something back. The nice question of what to do with all the good you've been handed.

body: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: The simplest, truest response to a good day: thanks, because it's good. No overthinking required.

body: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
modernText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
message: A house full of the sound of rejoicing. On a good day, be the place that sound is coming from.

body: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
modernText: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
message: Something good enough to be called the rejoicing of the heart. A gladness with real substance under it.

body: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
modernText: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
message: If today's a harvest after a hard season, enjoy it fully. The tears you planted are allowed to come back as joy.

body: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
modernText: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
message: Good and pleasant, the verse says of just being with people you love. If that's today, it counts as one of the best things there is.

body: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: The good you feel runs on a mercy that never quits. Today's gladness is drawing from a well that doesn't run dry.

body: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
modernText: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
message: Whole-hearted praise for a whole-hearted good mood. Nothing half about today, so hold nothing back.

body: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
modernText: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
message: An open hand feeding everything alive, including you, today. Good as the feeling of being provided for without even asking.

body: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
modernText: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
message: Good and pleasant, both, just to be glad. The verse makes gladness itself the point, not a means to anything.

body: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
modernText: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
message: Joyful, specifically, not just content. On a good day, you're allowed the upgraded version of fine.

body: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
modernText: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
message: A happy heart shows up on your face, and that's a good thing to let happen. Let the gladness reach your expression today.

body: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
modernText: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
message: Joy as actual medicine. A good mood isn't frivolous, it's doing something real for you. Take the dose.

body: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
modernText: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
message: From the most no-nonsense book in the Bible: rejoice and do good. Even the realist says the move is to enjoy it.

body: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
modernText: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
message: Go eat, drink, enjoy, it says plainly. Permission from scripture to savor the good things of an ordinary good day.

body: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
modernText: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
message: Sent out with joy, even the mountains and trees in on it. A good day where everything seems to be rooting for you.

body: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
modernText: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
message: Dressed up in good things, greatly rejoicing. On a good day, this says you're wearing the gladness, not borrowing it.

body: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
modernText: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
message: The specialty move: mourning turned into joy. If today's the turn, let yourself feel how far it came.

body: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
modernText: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
message: Sing, shout, be glad with the whole heart, the verse piles it on. When it's good, there's no such thing as too glad.

body: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
modernText: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
message: Spontaneous, spilling-over joy, the kind that just happens. If today feels like that, you're in good company with it.

body: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
modernText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
message: Joy named as something that grows in you, like fruit. A good mood as a sign of something quietly flourishing underneath.

body: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
modernText: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
message: A good day often comes with good people. Let yourself be thankful for the ones who make the remembering sweet.

body: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
modernText: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
message: Even the asking done with joy. On a good day, gladness colors everything, including the things you're hoping for.

body: Rejoice evermore.
modernText: Always rejoice.
message: Two words, no caveats: rejoice evermore. The shortest permission slip in the Bible to just be glad.

body: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
modernText: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
message: Praise called a sacrifice, an offering. On a good day, giving thanks isn't a chore, it's the easy, natural thing to lay down.

body: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
modernText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
message: A lively hope, the verse says, hope with a pulse. If today feels alive, that's the kind it means.

body: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
modernText: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
message: A picture of the biggest celebration there is. Today's good mood is a small rehearsal for that kind of gladness.

body: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
modernText: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
message: Joy that comes from someone else doing well. If today's good because of someone you love, this gets it, that's the best kind.

body: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
modernText: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
message: At all times, even the good ones, maybe especially the good ones. A practice of noticing the good out loud, not just when you need something.

body: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
modernText: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
message: A good day worth bragging about, in a way that makes others glad too. Joy that's contagious instead of showing off.

body: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
modernText: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
message: An invitation to not celebrate alone. Grab someone and be glad together, good days are better shared.

body: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
modernText: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
message: The soul, not just the surface, getting to be joyful. A good mood that reaches all the way in.

body: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
modernText: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
message: Not just joy, exceeding joy. The verse keeps reaching for a bigger word, and today you might know why.

body: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
modernText: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
message: Great things deserve a great response. On a good day, the gladness gets to be as big as the thing you're glad about.

body: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
modernText: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
message: If joy has been missing and today it came back, this names that exact relief. The return of gladness is worth marking.

body: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
modernText: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
message: Gladness listed like it's your right, your portion. On a good day, you're simply collecting what's yours.

body: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
modernText: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
message: Exceedingly rejoice, the verse insists, like it's worried you'll undersell it. Go all in on the gladness today.

body: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
modernText: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
message: Rejoicing tied to seeking, not to everything going perfectly. A good day as the natural fruit of looking in the right direction.

body: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
modernText: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
message: Sing aloud, not under your breath. When it's good, this says let it be audible, let the gladness take up space.

body: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
modernText: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
message: Gratitude called simply a good thing. On a good day it's also the easy thing, so don't overthink it, just be thankful.

body: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
modernText: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
message: Kindness noticed in the morning, gladness carried through the night. A good day that bookends itself with grace.

body: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
modernText: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
message: Rejoicing framed as fitting, as right for you. A good mood isn't a guilty pleasure here, it's exactly appropriate.

body: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
modernText: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
message: The whole land invited to make noise about it. On a good day, your gladness is part of a much bigger sound.

body: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
modernText: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
message: Even the ordinary doing of the day gets to be done glad. Gladness woven into the regular stuff, not saved for special occasions.

body: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
modernText: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
message: Filled with good things and renewed like an eagle. A good day as the feeling of being topped back up and ready.

body: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
modernText: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
message: The heart rejoicing, specifically for the ones who seek. If today feels good, maybe it's the quiet payoff of showing up.

body: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: The reason given is simple: he is good. On a day you feel it, the praise just agrees with what's already true.

body: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
modernText: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
message: Whole heart, in the company of others. A good day meant to be celebrated fully and together.

body: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.
modernText: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
message: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the good is worth noticing. Let gladness run the whole length of a good day.

body: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
modernText: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
message: Personal, direct: my God, and I will praise. A good day as a reason to make it personal, not abstract.

body: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
modernText: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
message: The same good refrain, bookending the psalm. Some truths are worth starting and ending the day on.

body: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
modernText: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
message: Gladness compared to coming into money. On a good day, this says the real wealth is the kind you're feeling right now.

body: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
modernText: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
message: Joy like stumbling on treasure. If today handed you something good, the verse says let it feel like the find it is.

body: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
modernText: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
message: Glad at the invitation itself, before anything even happened. A good day can start with just a 'let's,' and that's enough.

body: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
modernText: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
message: Shout for joy, the verse says, no need to keep it polite. On a good day, the volume's allowed to come up.

body: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
modernText: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
message: Happiness tied to belonging, to whose you are. A good day as a reminder of a steadier reason to be glad.

body: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
modernText: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
message: Every day, including the unremarkable good ones. A habit of gladness that doesn't wait for something big to happen.

body: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
modernText: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
message: Talking to your own soul on a good day: don't sleep on this, praise it, let yourself register how good it is.

body: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
modernText: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
message: A lifelong intention, renewed today. As long as there's breath, there's reason to be glad, and today you've got both.

body: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
modernText: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
message: Singing and thanks together, the natural pair on a good day. Gratitude that wants to come out as more than words.

body: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
modernText: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
message: Praise from the heights, from everything up high. A good day where even the sky seems to be in on the gladness.

body: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
modernText: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
message: The opening line of the Bible's biggest celebration. A good day as your personal entry into that praise.

body: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
modernText: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
message: Praise aimed at the specific good things done. On a good day, name the mighty act, don't just feel glad in general.

body: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
modernText: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
message: Heaven and earth both glad, the whole thing celebrating. Your good mood is part of a very large party.

body: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
modernText: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced; so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.
message: A celebration so loud it could be heard from far off. Some good days are meant to be unmissable, so let this one be.

body: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
modernText: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
message: Joy compared to harvest, to the payoff after the work. If today's a harvest, enjoy the yield, you earned the gladness.

body: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
modernText: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
message: The relief of a long wait finally arriving: we will be glad. If something you hoped for came, this is the verse for it.

body: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
modernText: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
message: Joy that lasts and sorrow that leaves. A good day as a preview of the direction things are ultimately heading.

body: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
modernText: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
message: The sighing packing up and leaving, joy moving in. If today feels like that shift, let it fully arrive.

body: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
modernText: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.
message: Told to be glad in the new thing being made. A good day as a small piece of something being created fresh.

body: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
modernText: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
message: After a hard season, a direct command to be glad again. If the drought broke, this says go ahead and celebrate the rain.

body: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
modernText: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
message: The original good news, announced as great joy for all people. A good day as your share in that announcement.

body: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
modernText: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
message: A reason to be glad that nothing in the day can undo. Underneath the good mood, a steadier gladness that's already secured.

body: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
modernText: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
message: Joy that can't be stolen, the verse promises. On a good day, this says the gladness is actually yours to keep.

body: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
modernText: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;
message: Gladness anchored in hope, not just circumstances. A good day that has somewhere to come from even when things are plainer.

body: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
modernText: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
message: Always caused to triumph, the verse says, always. If today feels like a win, it's part of a longer streak than you'd guess.

body: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
modernText: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
message: Rejoice, Paul writes, from prison. If he could land on gladness from there, your good day has every reason to lean in.

body: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
modernText: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
message: A future of being presented faultless, with exceeding joy. A good day as a small taste of how that will feel.

body: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
modernText: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
message: An ask for a face to brighten toward you. A good day as the feeling of being looked at warmly, light landing where you are.

body: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
modernText: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
message: Gladness bigger than a good harvest, bigger than the stuff people usually celebrate. If today's joy runs deeper than its reasons, this gets it.

body: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
modernText: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
message: A quiet look at where your life has landed and calling it pleasant. On a good day, this says the plot you got is a good one.

body: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
modernText: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
message: Thankful even for the guidance that got you here. A good day as a chance to be glad for the quiet help along the way.

body: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
modernText: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
message: A longing just to look at something beautiful. On a good day, permission to stop and simply take the goodness in.

body: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
modernText: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.
message: Joy offered up like a gift, not just felt. A good day as something you get to give back, gladly.

body: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
modernText: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
message: An invitation to join the singing. On a good day, you're not making the gladness up, you're joining in with it.

body: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
modernText: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
message: The whole earth, full of goodness, if you look. A good day as one of the places that fullness shows up for you.

body: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
modernText: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
message: Faces lifted and lit up, not ashamed. A good day as the feeling of looking up and brightening without even trying.

body: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
modernText: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
message: No good thing lacking, for those who seek. If today feels full, this says that's the pattern, not the exception.

body: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
modernText: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
message: Abundantly satisfied, not just topped off. A good day as the rare, full feeling of having more than enough.

body: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
modernText: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
message: A fountain, not a trickle, the source of life itself. On a good day, you're drinking from something that doesn't run dry.

body: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
modernText: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
message: Delight in peace, the quiet kind of good. A day that's good not because it's loud, but because it's calm and full.

body: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
modernText: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
message: Praise rooted in something already done, already settled. A good day standing on ground laid long before today.

body: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
modernText: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
message: Satisfied, filled up with goodness. On a good day, this names the feeling of simply having had enough good.

body: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
modernText: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
message: Both ends of the day set rejoicing. A good day as one where even the sunrise and sunset seem glad.

body: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
modernText: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
message: Gladness that spreads to everyone, not hoarded. A good day as the kind that makes you want others in on it too.

body: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
modernText: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
message: A mouth filled with praise, overflowing. On a good day, let the gladness be the thing that keeps coming out.

body: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
modernText: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
message: A good day that sharpens what actually matters. The quiet realization that the best thing you have isn't a thing at all.

body: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
modernText: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
message: Simply: it is good to be near. A good day as the plain, uncomplicated gladness of closeness.

body: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
modernText: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
message: A whole-body longing, met. On a good day, the ache and the answer meet in the same place.

body: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
modernText: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you.
message: Blessed are the ones who get to stay and keep being glad. A good day as a taste of that settled, ongoing joy.

body: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
modernText: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
message: All the heart, nothing held in reserve. On a good day, you get to be glad without hedging.

body: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
modernText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
message: Flourishing, not just surviving. If today feels like growth, this says that's what you were made to do.

body: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
modernText: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
message: Mercy as high as the sky is above the earth. A good day resting on something immeasurably large underneath it.

body: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
modernText: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
message: The longing soul satisfied, the hungry filled with goodness. A good day as that exact feeling of a need finally met.

body: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
modernText: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
message: Remembered, kept in mind, and blessed. On a good day, this says the good wasn't random, you were thought of.

body: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
modernText: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
message: Gracious and merciful, the character behind a good day. The gladness has a kind source, not just lucky timing.

body: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
modernText: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
message: Good, and does good, the verse says plainly. A good day as that goodness simply doing what it does.

body: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
modernText: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
message: The good of people, of family, named as a gift and a reward. If today's good because of someone in your life, this honors that.

body: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
modernText: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
message: Blessing offered to every one, not a select few. A good day as proof the blessing has your name on it too.

body: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
modernText: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
message: Happy, and well with you. Two of the simplest, best words, said straight to you on a good day.

body: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
modernText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
message: A good day to remember you're wonderfully made, not accidentally. The gladness extends even to how you were put together.

body: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
modernText: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
message: Great things, greatly praised. On a good day, the size of the gladness gets to match the size of the good.

body: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
modernText: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
message: Gracious, compassionate, patient, the character under a good day. The goodness you feel has a gentle source.

body: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
modernText: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
message: Here's the lovely twist: pleasure taken in you. On a good day, picture being someone's delight, not just delighting.

body: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
modernText: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.
message: The oldest blessing there is, said over you: blessed and kept. A good day as that blessing actually landing.

body: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
modernText: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
message: A face shining toward you, gracious. On a good day, this says that warmth you feel is a face turned your way.

body: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
modernText: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.
message: A command, almost: thou shalt surely rejoice. On a good day, you have permission, even instruction, to be glad.

body: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
modernText: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
message: Strength and gladness in the same room. A good day where feeling strong and feeling happy aren't at odds.

body: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
modernText: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
message: The kind of rich that doesn't come with a catch. A good day as blessing without the usual sorrow tacked on.

body: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
modernText: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
message: Happiness linked to trust, something steadier than luck. A good day with roots that go deeper than circumstance.

body: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
modernText: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
message: From the Bible's biggest skeptic: there's nothing better than enjoying your work and your bread. High praise for an ordinary good day.

body: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
modernText: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
message: The ability to actually enjoy what you have, called a gift. If today you can enjoy it, that's its own blessing.

body: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
modernText: then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.
message: Delight, the verse instructs, like joy is something you're allowed to choose. A good day as the easiest day to take it up on the offer.

body: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
modernText: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
message: Grace layered on grace, fullness received. A good day as one more wave of a kindness that keeps coming.

body: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
modernText: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
message: Not just life, abundant life, is the stated goal. A good day as a glimpse of the fullness it's pointing at.

body: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
modernText: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
message: Hearts filled with food and gladness, the ordinary good of being fed and happy. A good day as evidence of that quiet kindness.

body: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
modernText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
message: Blessed with all of them, the verse says, all. A good day as one of those blessings becoming something you can actually feel.

body: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
modernText: Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
message: Given richly, to enjoy, not just to endure. A good day as permission to actually take pleasure in the good things you've got.

body: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
modernText: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
message: Glad and rejoicing, stacked together like one isn't enough. A good day where the gladness just keeps doubling up.

body: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
modernText: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
message: Looking back and realizing how generously things turned out. A good day worth a song because the dealing was bountiful.

body: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
modernText: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
message: Joy that comes from leaning on strength that isn't your own. A good day as the ease of not having to be the strong one.

body: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
modernText: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
message: Everyone who's looking gets in on the gladness. A good day as the shared payoff of a lot of quiet seeking.

body: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
modernText: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
message: A whole people glad at once. On a good day, your gladness is a thread in something much bigger and older.

body: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
modernText: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
message: Sing, rejoice, be glad before him, the verse keeps nudging. On a good day, it's just encouraging you to lean all the way in.

body: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
modernText: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
message: A song as the natural overflow of a good day. When gladness gets big enough, it stops being words and starts being music.

body: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
modernText: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
message: The humble ones, the quiet ones, getting to be glad. A good day that the understated people get to fully enjoy too.

body: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
modernText: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
message: Revived back into rejoicing after a flat stretch. If today brought you back to life a little, this names that return.

body: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
modernText: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
message: Rejoicing all day long, not just a flicker. A good day with staying power, gladness that lasts past the first hour.

body: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
modernText: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
message: Heaven and earth both in on it. A good day where it feels like the whole world is quietly celebrating with you.

body: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
modernText: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
message: Even the fields joyful, the trees singing. A good day where the ordinary outside world seems to be glad too.

body: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
modernText: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
message: A reason to be glad that sits above the day's details: someone good is in charge. The earth rejoicing because of who's reigning.

body: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
modernText: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
message: Hearing good news and just being glad about it. A good day as the simple gladness of a report that went the right way.

body: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
modernText: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
message: Here's the lovely part: the maker rejoicing in what he made, which includes you. A good day where you're something being delighted in.

body: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
modernText: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
message: Thanksgiving offered, good news told with rejoicing. A good day as something worth announcing, not just quietly keeping.

body: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
modernText: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
message: Greatly praise, out loud. On a good day, the gladness gets to leave your head and actually be said.

body: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
modernText: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
message: Good, and praising him is pleasant, the verse says. A good day where being thankful is itself one of the pleasures.

body: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
modernText: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
message: Good things worth passing on, telling the next person. A good day that becomes a story you'll tell later.

body: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
modernText: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
message: Dwelling on the wondrous, the glorious. A good day as a chance to think about something bigger than the usual worries.

body: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
modernText: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
message: Everything made joining the praise, and you're one of the works. A good day as your part in a chorus that includes the whole world.

body: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
modernText: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
message: The mouth that complains on hard days gets to praise on good ones. Let today's gladness do the talking.

body: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
modernText: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
message: A whole city called to praise. A good day as your invitation to join a gladness much larger than yourself.

body: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
modernText: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
message: Praise aimed at the one excellent name. A good day as a reason to look up and marvel, not just feel good.

body: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
modernText: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
message: A new song, not a recycled one. When today is genuinely good, it deserves fresh words, not the old tired ones.

body: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
modernText: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
message: Joyful in glory, glad even in your rest. A good day where even winding down gets to feel like celebration.

body: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
modernText: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
message: Excellent things done, worth singing about. A good day as evidence that something is being done well on your behalf.

body: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
modernText: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
message: Cry out and shout, the verse says, no inside voice required. On a good day, the gladness is allowed to be loud.

body: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
modernText: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
message: A new song rising from everywhere at once. A good day as your voice in a worldwide, spontaneous gladness.

body: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
modernText: Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.
message: The heavens told to sing because it's done, finished, accomplished. A good day as the relief of something being handled.

body: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
modernText: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
message: Singing because comfort came. If today is good after a hard time, this is the verse for that exact turn.
